A '''male weapons officer''' served aboard the modified [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']].

==History==
During the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] campaign against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], the weapon's officer was assigned to the recently captured [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']], a modified [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that [[Wraith Squadron]] managed to capture from Zsinj's fleet. His assignment was due to the loss of the ship's entire bridge crew&mdash;with the exception of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Atril Tabanne]]&mdash;during the [[Battle of Talasea]]. The weapon's officer would later survive the [[Battle of Ession|battle]] between the New Republic and Zsinj's vassal [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit]] on the planet [[Ession]].<ref name="WS" />

The weapons officer was remarkably in awe when acting [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] told him that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] who accepted Antilles's offer of ceasing hostilities was none other than the famed Imperial pilot [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]].<ref name="WS" />
